name: Pelatiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return

points: The spirit lifted Ezekiel up and brought him to the east gate of the Lord's house, where he saw five and twenty men, among whom were Jaazaniah the son of Azur and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah, princes of the people; remember the name Pelatiah.

note.label: Ezekiel 11: This City Shall Not Be Your Cauldron

points: While Ezekiel was prophesying, Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died, one of the wicked men that had given wicked counsel, put to death by the Most High.

note.label: Ezekiel 11: This City Shall Not Be Your Cauldron

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org

cases.name: Pelatiah and the princes at the east gate
cases.charge: Devising mischief and giving wicked counsel in the city: it is not near; let us build houses: this city is the caldron, and we be the flesh
